paragraphs: I'm a product engineer who takes end-to-end ownership of building products that solve meaningful customer and business problems.
I'm looking for product engineering or forward-deployed software engineering roles where I can work closely with customers, leverage the right tools, and deliver high-impact solutions.
My overarching career goal is to leverage technology to help others live their best lives.

education.degree: BS in Computer Science, Minor in Psychology

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Leading a remote-first team of 10 engineers as the only product manager on the therapist experience team.

Launched a consolidated Google calendar app using Cobalt RPA and Nylas Calendar API, decreasing schedule management effort by 75%, increasing provider availability by 1.5× to support 200 additional quarterly bookings and $2M ARR, while mitigating scheduling conflicts for 9K clients without follow-up appointments.

Led the design and launch of a database supporting provider biographies on client booking pages (150K+ monthly visits), ingesting 50+ data fields to generate 15k provider bios weekly, and serving consumer requests at 99.9% availability.

Reduced provider onboarding time by 25% and saved $600K annually by auditing 10+ software systems, deprecating 3 of them, and replacing them with Tellescope CRM and Zendesk AI chatbot in partnership with Clinical Operations and Credentialing.

Built an end-to-end provider onboarding pipeline for Octave’s B2B2C partnership with Cigna using Tellescope CRM, Tray.ai agentic workflows, and Descope authentication, supporting 10K eligible providers and reducing manual work by 50%.

experience.title: Technical Program Manager II
bullets: Mitigated $65M in annual revenue loss by leading adoption of the Commerce Manifest declarative API for all Azure teams to efficiently submit pricing updates and avoid undercharging B2B customers.

Developed and operationalized an Azure-wide S360 KPI to track Commerce Manifest adoption by team. Oversaw successful KPI implementation for 30 Azure teams and resolved 3,000+ pricing discrepancies. Wrote inaugural technical documentation for Commerce Manifest.

Empowered Engineering to exceed monthly OKRs for reliability and performance in our price-publishing engine. Maintained >99.99% API reliability and all APIs in SLA to publish pricing changes within 3 business days.

experience.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Provided product strategy and technical consulting for a 15-person startup in the mental health space.

Created and executed product roadmap for a relationship-based AI-powered algorithm to match clients with therapists. Led the engineering, design, and product teams to launch MVP website, securing a round of seed funding.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
bullets: Service owner for 2 big-data ingestion services that manage $4B+ in first-party commercial product revenue. Developed Angular components for 30+ Microsoft tenants for the Azure Marketplace pricing tool.
Slashed most-used page load time by 75% by optimizing C# .NET query performance and adding 10 new alerts in Azure Application Insights to detect performance anomalies.

Drove cross-collaboration with Shanghai team to migrate all price-publishing services from Azure Cloud Services to Azure Kubernetes in 3 months. Created documentation to guide the team through Docker and YML setup, deployment, and testing.
Implemented certificate auto-rotation for all 6 services to reduce the number of high severity on-call incidents by 25%.
